classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the given angle as included between the two labelled sides and substitute directly into the triangle area formula.

content.prompt: Find the area of triangle $XYZ$, correct to two decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with X upper left, Y lower left and Z right; ordinary source-blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: XY = 6.2 cm, XZ = 8.3 cm and included angle YXZ = 72 degrees. YZ has no supplied length.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Area of }\triangle XYZ&=\frac12\times XY\times XZ\times\sin\angle YXZ\\
\text{Area of }\triangle XYZ&=\frac12\times6.2\times8.3\times\sin72^\circ\\
\text{Area of }\triangle XYZ&\approx24.47\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
